text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my. Those bags... Shall I help you 
carry them?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. Despite my looks, my physical 
strength is no different from anyone 
else's. Leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—Right. Just to be safe, may I ask what's 
inside? We certainly can't risk breaking 
it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Hmm, foam rollers and barbells... I see...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I have fully grasped the contents. Now 
then, shall we carry it? ...Hehe.
